reason: This is not a narrow DDL-only tweak: it adds a new table-level feature and touches core planning entrypoints (`pkg/planner/core/optimizer.go`, `pkg/planner/core/resolve/resolve.go`, `pkg/planner/optimize.go`) plus executor-side infoschema exposure. A new `TableMode` can easily alter name resolution, optimization gating, and user-visible table behavior across many statements, which is exactly the kind of planner/executor semantic surface where Blocker/High issues can hide.
